text:
mira: Quick spot-check from today's onboard canary for zephyr-lite q4f (int8). We're seeing consistent detokenization and ligature breakage tied to U+200C (ZWNonJoiner) and some ruby/furigana runs in JP.

mira: TL;DR numbers: ja BLEU 22.0 (-3.4 vs fp32), zh BLEU 29.0 (-0.4), ar BLEU 16.8 (-4.9). Failures cluster where ZWNJ/U+200C sits between an ideograph/letter and punctuation or in the middle of Arabic ligature runs.

mira: Minimal examples I dropped into the S3 bundle (will share link):
- JP: Input: "\u6b21\u306e\u30ab\u30c6\u30b4\u30ea\u30fc\u200c\u3002" -> Output int8: "\u6b21\u306e\u30ab\u30c6\u30b4\u30ea \u3002" (space inserted, ZWNJ lost)
- AR: Input: "\u0627\u0644\u0623\u062d\u0628\u200c\u0627\u0644\u0645" -> Output int8: ligature broken, mirroring oddities.

devon: Did anything change in the compressed-vocab remap since the last canary? We folded several zero-width variants to reduce table size for q4f.

ash: Also check the detokenization layer: we added a caching optimization that assumes token id stability across remap. If remap changed ordering, cached detok ranges could resolve to wrong glyph sequences.

mira: Bisecting locally:
- fp32 + tokenizer v2 => baseline OK
- int8(q4f) + tokenizer v2 => repro
- int8 + tokenizer v1 => partial repro (smaller delta)
So likely an interaction between quant remap/packing + tokenizer normalization for ZWNJ.

eva: Can you upload token-id traces for input and output for 12 examples? I want to add them to a paired significance run and compute token-substitution matrices.

mira: Uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/zephyr/1767001234-zwnj-traces.tar.gz (includes token ids, detok snapshots, and raw logits for suspect spans).

kai: @eval-bot kick off a compare job: zephyr-lite fp32 vs q4f-int8 on the zwnj subset. Request token-diff matrix and per-sample mirroring/space-insert flags.

eval-bot: Compare job queued: compare-zwnj-1767001234. Link: https://ci.redwood/zephyr/compare/1767001234

devon: For a quick isolate: run the q4f artifact with remap_passthrough=true and kernel=fp32-emulate. If remap_passthrough fixes it, the remap folding is the culprit. If fp32-emulate fixes it, it might be packing/numeric.

mira: Running both now. Also testing with prefix_cache disabled (cache_affinity=off) to rule out KV index skew. Will post results in ~20-30m.

ash: If this is remap+cache interaction, short-term mitigations: pin tokenizer v1 for int8 canary, set remap_passthrough=true in runtime, and add a detok-sanity check that rejects any output where ZWNJ disappears next to punctuation.

eva: I'll add a synthetic test to the harness that injects ZWNJ between common ligature pairs and fails canary if token-substitution rate > 1% or BLEU drop > 2.0 on the mini-suite. ETA EOD.

eval-bot: Compare finished: zephyr-lite q4f-int8 vs fp32 summary: JA BLEU -3.3, AR BLEU -4.8, flagged 102/130 ZWNJ-related anomalies. Token-diff matrices uploaded. Link: https://ci.redwood/zephyr/compare/1767001234/results

mira: Remap_passthrough result: with remap_passthrough=true, detok issues drop substantially (JA BLEU delta -0.6 vs fp32). fp32-emulate kernel also reduces errors but remap_passthrough gives the biggest improvement.

devon: That points to remap folding being applied inconsistently between encode/decode or between tokenizer and runtime remap table. I'll audit the compact table packing and the remap serialization in the onboarding artifact.

ash: Plan:
1) Temporary: set remap_passthrough=true for q4f canary and pin tokenizer v1 for q4f until we fix serialization (Ops/Infra config change).
2) Dev: audit and fix remap folding/tables (devon, ETA EOD).
3) Eval: add ZWNJ synthetic test and detok-sanity gating (eva, ETA EOD).

mira: I'll coordinate with infra if we need to flip remap_passthrough on staging. Posting follow-up after audit.

kai: Thanks — please include a short blurb for the staging run notes so SRE knows why we toggled remap_passthrough. :thumbsup:

mira: Will do.
